Photij: in illa, vt mos erat, primi Legati

est. Pudebat scilicet illum in similibus nævis,
& patentibus Hagitijs sui nominis sub-

quod non veritus est Imperator, & illius fi-
lij. Septimæ Synodi Patres in literis Pon-
tificijs contenta, absque vllo examine exo-

reluctantur, & apertissime aduersantur,
clamantque, indebite illa sibi a Pontifice
imponi: nunc ea se recipere, si suo vsui fu-
tura sunt, dictitant: nunc sibi propofita a
Pontifice despicientes silentio prætereunt.

page.notes: The Greek word in the Actionibus line is not legible enough to copy letter by letter; marked illegible. The printed text has "Photius" in the margin of the Greek line and a faint mark before "Photio" in the first line, which is not a printed letter. The catchword "de-" is the start of the next page's first word. Printed spellings such as "Hagitijs", "Photianæ" and "propofita" are kept as printed.
